info.name: Convex Deployment Platform AccessTokens CustomDomains API

params.name: deployment_name
params.description: The unique name of the deployment (e.g. "happy-otter-123"). This is the subdomain portion of the deployment URL at convex.cloud.

items.docs: Associates a custom domain with a Convex deployment. Supports two request destination types: convexCloud for routing to the function API (queries, mutations, actions), and convexSite for routing to HTTP action endpoints. Domain verification and DNS configuration is handled separately.

info.name: List custom domains for a deployment

params.name: deployment_name
params.description: The unique name of the deployment (e.g. "happy-otter-123"). This is the subdomain portion of the deployment URL at convex.cloud.

items.docs: Returns all custom domains configured for a deployment. Each entry includes the domain name, request destination type, and verification status.

params.name: deployment_name
params.description: The unique name of the deployment (e.g. "happy-otter-123"). This is the subdomain portion of the deployment URL at convex.cloud.

items.docs: Removes a custom domain association from a Convex deployment. After deletion, traffic to the domain will no longer be routed to the deployment. DNS records should be removed separately.
